title: SpecNode
description: Base schema for all spec node types. Each node type schema extends this with type-specific attribute constraints via allOf.

id.description: Unique node instance identifier (UUIDv4). Globally unique across the entire model.

spec_node_id.description: Reference to the spec node type that this node conforms to (e.g., 'motivation.goal')

type.description: Denormalized node type for efficient filtering and queries. Extracted from spec_node_id (the part after the dot).

layer_id.description: Denormalized layer ID for efficient layer-scoped queries. Extracted from spec_node_id (the part before the dot).

description.description: Optional detailed description of this specific node instance

attributes.description: Attribute values for this node instance. Keys must correspond to attributes defined in the per-type schema, and values must conform to the type constraints.

source_reference.description: Optional provenance tracking linking this node to source code locations

accepted_gaps.description: Optional list of connections the relationship catalog allows for this node's type that are deliberately absent, each with its reason. One entry names one triple, seen from this node: the direction, the predicate and the other end's spec node type. It tells 'decided against' apart from 'not modelled yet': planning and extraction stop proposing the connection, and verification reports the gap as contradicted when the code shows the connection exists. An accepted gap never makes validation fail, does not expire (it stays until reopened), and cannot be accepted for a relationship the catalog marks required.

direction.description: 'outgoing' when this node would be the relationship's source, 'incoming' when it would be the target

predicate.description: The relationship predicate from the predicate catalog (e.g. 'realizes', 'accesses')

other_spec_node_id.description: Spec node type of the other end (e.g. 'data-store.collection'). With direction and predicate it names one triple the relationship catalog defines

reason.description: Why the connection does not apply to this node

decided_by.description: Who accepted the gap: a person, or the agent that staged it

decided_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the gap was accepted

changeset.description: Id of the changeset the gap was staged in

metadata.description: Optional metadata about the lifecycle and version of this node instance

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this node was created

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last modification

created_by.description: User or system that created this node

version.description: Version number of this node (incremented on updates)
